signInSubtitle: Sign in with Solar Network to continue.
activeWorkspaceRequired: An active workspace is required to use SolWatt.
oauthDescription: OAuth authorization uses the Solar Network identity service.
signOutDescription: Clear this session and return to the gate
requiresStellarSupernova: Requires Stellar Supernova (perk {perkLevel}+). You are on {perkTierName} (perk {level}).
assignedElsewhere: Assigned to a workspace you may not list here
notAssigned: Not assigned — open Plan & quotas on a workspace you own.
createBoardToOrganize: Create a board to organize tasks in this workspace.
selectWorkspaceBeforeCreatingBoard: Select a workspace before creating a board.
boardIconDescription: Displayed on the boards grid and list.
name: Name
taskPrefixDescription: Auto-generated prefix for task IDs (e.g. PROJ-1).
addTaskOrCreateGroups: Add a task or create groups for this board.
chooseWorkspaceToBrowse: Choose a workspace to browse its files.
uploadFilesOrCreateFolder: Upload files or create a folder. Storage uses the workspace plan quota, not your personal Drive.
uploadLogosAndBackgrounds: Upload logos, board icons, or backgrounds here. They stay out of the folder tree.
permanentlyDelete: Permanently delete "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
openFoldersDescription: Open a Folders tab to browse the workspace tree, or an Assets tab for unindexed logos and backgrounds.
searchAccountToInvite: Search for an account to invite.
selectWorkspaceToSeeStorage: Select a workspace to see storage
onlyOwnerCanPurchase: Only the workspace owner can purchase a paid plan.
alreadyOnEnterprise: This workspace is already on Enterprise.
onlyOwnerCanManageSeat: Only the workspace owner can manage this seat.
assignBundledProConfirm: Apply your Solarpass perk Pro plan to {name}? You can only assign it to one workspace at a time. Moving it later has a 7-day cooldown.
removeBundledProConfirm: {name} will return to the Free plan and lower resource limits.
createPaymentOrderNoPrice: Create a payment order for the {plan} plan on {name}. You will finish payment on Solian.
createPaymentOrderWithPrice: Create a payment order for {plan} ({price}) on {name}. You will finish payment on Solian.
orderCreatedScanQr: Order created — scan the QR code or open solian.app/orders/{orderId} to pay.
browserTabMayHaveOpened: A browser tab may have opened. You can also scan this QR code with your phone to pay in the Solian app.
scanQrToPay: Scan this QR code with your phone to pay in the Solian app, or open the link on this device.
afterPaymentSettles: After payment settles, return here and refresh plan status.
inviteToCollaborate: Invite people to collaborate in this workspace.
removeMemberConfirm: This member will lose access to the workspace.
workspaceIconDescription: Shown in the workspace list and gate.
deleteWorkspaceConfirm: This permanently deletes the workspace and its data.
notificationsEmptyDescription: SolWatt alerts for this account will show up here.
githubDescription: Link repositories to "{name}". Issues become tasks; title, body, labels, open/closed state, and comments sync both ways.
notConnectedDescription: Install the WattEngine GitHub App, then choose repositories to sync with this board.
waitingForGitHub: Waiting for GitHub to finish… return here after you approve the app and grant repository access. Organization policy may require owner approval.
openInstallPage: Open the install page, grant repository access, then return to SolWatt.
chooseRepositoryToLink: Choose a repository to link. You can add more repositories afterward.
noRepositoriesDescription: Grant the app access to at least one repository, then try again.
linkedImportQueued: Import queued or not synced yet
supportedFields: Supported fields: title ↔ name, body ↔ content, labels ↔ tags, open/closed ↔ incomplete/completed, issue comments ↔ task comments. Groups, priority, due dates, assignees, and attachments stay in SolWatt only.
linkedRepo: Linked {name}. Issues are importing as tasks.
githubSyncQueued: GitHub sync queued. It will continue in the background.
unlinkGitHubConfirm: Tasks stay on the board. GitHub issues, comments, and the app installation are not deleted. Sync will stop for {name}.
commentsDescription: GitHub issue comments appear here and stay read-only. You can edit or delete only comments you wrote in SolWatt.
deleteCommentConfirm: This comment will be removed. If it was synced to GitHub, the issue comment is deleted too.
noWorkspacesEmpty: No workspaces yet. Create one to continue.
noRepositoriesGranted: No repositories were granted to the app. Install again and select at least one repository.
deleteGroupConfirm: Tasks in this group stay on the board and become ungrouped.
organizeBoardTasks: Organize board tasks into columns or swimlanes.
createGroupToOrganize: Create a group to organize tasks.
unindexedAssetsDescription: Unindexed workspace assets are ideal for logos and backgrounds. They still bill to the workspace plan.
workspaceFilesDescription: Workspace-owned files retain the uploader account for audit while storage is billed to the workspace plan.
searchAccountToAssign: Search for an account to assign.
noEmailsDescription: Select a mailbox to load messages.
subject: Subject
mailboxAddressHelperWithHost: Local mailbox name. The server appends @{host}.
mailboxAddressHelperNoHost: Local mailbox name. No mail host is configured on the server.
mailboxAddressInvalid: Address must be a valid email (e.g. alice@example.com).
mailboxAddressInvalidSend: This mailbox address cannot send mail. The server has no mail host configured.
saveSecretOnce: Save this secret now — it is shown only once.
noCredentialsDescription: Create app-password credentials for desktop mail clients.
revokeCredentialConfirm: Revoke "{label}"? This will stop any mail client using it from signing in.
